# Dark Matter™

> Dark Matter™ is a haute couture house from another reality. Fashion first, with horror only as the turn. Season 01 runs from 30 September to 28 November 2026: nine collections, twenty-seven shows, a new look every night until the finale.

The site is one page in English, with a Spanish version behind the EN/ES switch. It has two views: The films and The season. How the house makes its work is not public; the packs open the atelier to those who buy them.

## The films
- [The muses](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#hall): a hall of screens where the house muses wait: The Silver Bishop, The Red Bride, The Albino and The Machine.
- [The invitation](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#invite): you were not invited. You came anyway.
- [The silhouettes](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#dust): three looks from the new season, made of dust.
- [The film](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#film): twenty-five seconds from the other side.
- [The runway](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#runway): eight worlds, each with its own film.
- [The encounter](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#enc): someone in the audience has not looked at the runway once. Includes a short game, Hold her gaze.
- [The exit](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#exit): questions, a contact form that replies by DM, and the finale.

## The season
- [Season 01 program](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#season): nine collections, twenty-seven shows, sixty nights.
- [The packs](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#library): the prompts and the pipeline behind the season, to make the same films look by look.
  - The Look, 9 USD, one payment: one look, from the first image to the finished film.
  - The World, 19 USD, one payment: one week of the season, one world and every look in it.
  - The Season, 49 USD, one payment: everything behind Season 01, with a new world every Wednesday until 28.11.
- [Commissions](https://darkmatter-tm.pages.dev/#comm): music videos, fashion films and campaign worlds in the house style. Every commission is quoted by DM.
